Across all six deliverables, every parameter (FCF, WACC, g, EBITDA, net debt, comparables, discounts, threshold rate, waterfall, paid-in capital, cash/payables, SEC registers) traces to attachments 1–12 and is explicitly attributed via MAP-04/VAL/ST/RPT IDs. No external industry database, third-party valuation report, market data source, or self-invented ratio is used. Stress-scenario inputs are manager-defined scenario parameters, not external third-party data. MAP-06 explicitly concludes '本轮所有参数均可映射至附件1—12，未新增折扣、WACC、永续增长率或分配顺序', which is verifiable against the source attachments.
